soal_06_stimulus_01.png.description:
Infographic titled "Effective Study Techniques" (two columns, ten numbered items; each item has a numbered circle and an icon). Left column then right column, top to bottom:
1 (head with play/sound icons) "Know Your Learning Style" - "Understand whether you learn best by reading, listening, or watching."
2 (calendar icon) "Set a Consistent Study Schedule" - "Study at the same time every day. Regularity helps build strong habits."
3 (desk with lamp icon) "Create a Comfortable Study Space" - "Find a quite, well-lit, and distraction-free area. Have all your materials ready."
4 (tomato icon marked "25") "Use the Pomodoro Technique" - "Study for 25 minutes, then take a 5-minute break. This keeps your mind fresh and focused."
5 (notes/mind-map icon) "Take Effective Notes" - "Write key points using methods like mind maps or tables to help remember important information."
6 (clipboard with check icon) "Practice and Repeat" - "Regularly review your material and do practice-questions to deepen understanding and improve retention."
7 (speech bubbles and people icon) "Join a Study Group" - "Discuss topics with friends to gain new insights and solve problems together."
8 (phone with graduation-cap icon) "Leverage Technology" - "Use apps and websites for flashcards, video lessons, and online quizzes to support your study routine."
9 (sleeping person icon with "z z") "Get Enough Sleep" - "Aim for 7-8 hours."
10 (hourglass icon) "Be Patient and Persistent" - "Learning takes time."

soal_21_stimulus_01.png.description: Watercolour-style illustration with no text. On a savanna with dry grass, acacia trees and clouds: a large male lion with a full dark mane sits at the left in side view, looking to the right; at the right, a smaller lion-like character with a reddish mane stands upright on its hind legs with both arms raised and its mouth wide open with closed eyes, appearing to laugh or dance; behind it, two spotted animals resembling hyenas with open mouths are visible; a small dirt mound is in the foreground centre.
